summary: Join our Sustainable Livelihoods in Rural Areas Training to gain essential skills for fostering economic growth and environmental stewardship in rural.
lede: Sustainable livelihoods training helps development practitioners assess rural community resources, risks and livelihood options. It is for rural development officers, program managers, public-sector staff, and community and resilience practitioners who plan or evaluate livelihood programs. Participants learn to map livelihood assets, assess vulnerabilities and market systems, design diversified strategies, support community-led planning, and monitor livelihood outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals actively engaged in development programs and rural transformation initiatives.
audience: Rural development officers and field practitioners
Government officials in agriculture, social protection
Social protection and safety net program officers
Youth and women empowerment project teams
modules: Market Systems and Rural Enterprise Development
Program Planning and Value for Money
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning for Livelihoods
Risk Reduction, Resilience Building, and Adaptation
Communicating, Reporting, and Scaling Livelihood Interventions
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of rural development concepts and experience working in development programs or rural communities. A background in agriculture, social sciences, or economics is beneficial but not required.
